finite_limits.scope: Frozen source-backed templates; every task already exists. Dimension, seed, identity, global matrix renaming and statement/choice order are not fresh variants.

exceptions.easy: No source-backed easy workload or field/template contract validated; absence alone does not prove mathematical impossibility. New evidence reopens classification.
exceptions.moderate: All extracted tasks already exist; no mathematically fresh dimension/seed variants. Existing stock is rechecked, not replenished with duplicates.
exceptions.hard: All extracted tasks already exist; retain reserve shortage explicitly. New law combinations or new operations require new source-backed extraction and validation.
